products.name: Make (Integromat) AI
products.note: Visual automation platform; AI integrations; EU-hosted options; GDPR workflow compliance

profile_text.body:
Make is a visual workflow automation platform founded in 2015 and now part of Celonis. The company describes itself as serving over 400,000 organizations across 200+ countries with a global team of more than 350 people. Its platform allows users to build, scale, and automate AI and agentic workflows through a no-code visual interface, written code, or natural language prompts, and it connects to apps, data sources, and AI models across use cases including IT operations, marketing, lead management, and CRM.

Make's core product, tracked on this site as Make (Integromat) AI, offers more than 400 pre-built AI app integrations and supports the creation and management of AI agents alongside human teams. The platform includes EU-hosted options and is positioned to support GDPR workflow compliance, reflecting a deliberate focus on data residency and regulatory requirements for European customers.

No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the held facts for this company.
